worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.summary: Exhale a wide, slow cloud of cold: every enemy it covers takes Ice special damage that always lands a critical hit and is left chilled, and the ground freezes over. Wide catches more; narrow is faster, longer and heavier.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.use.0: Cover a clustered group of enemies
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.use.1: Suppress a group with guaranteed critical cold
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.use.2: Lay a numbing frost across a chokepoint
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.descriptio: Every enemy the cloud covers takes about %1$s Ice special damage across a %2$s-degree fan, and the hit always lands as a critical.
The cloud reaches %1$s blocks, drifting out at %2$s blocks/tick; it settles only when it arrives, so stepping out of it dodges the attack.
Covered enemies are chilled for %1$s and move 28% slower, and each leaves about %2$s blocks of frost underfoot that lingers %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.wide.on: Wide breath: a broader fan, a thicker cloud, more frost and a longer chill, at the cost of reach, cloud speed, some power, and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.wide.off: Narrow breath: a narrow, long, fast, heavy stream of cold, at the cost of coverage.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.growth.0: From level %1$s the cold rises to %2$s power and a %3$s-degree fan.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.growth.1: From level %1$s the cold rises to %2$s power, %3$s blocks of frost and %4$s of chill.
worldcombat.skill.frostbreath.preference: On (wide): fan x1.35, thicker cloud, more and longer frost and chill, but reach x0.85, cloud x0.8, power x0.92, +2 ticks wind-up and +5 ticks cooldown. Off (narrow): a narrow, long, fast, heavy stream, at the cost of coverage.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before exhaling; larger values let it open from further away.
On: an enemy with more enemies packed around it ranks higher, because one fan covers several. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
